title: Blender bouncing-ball animation via Claude MCP integration
goal: Using a custom Claude MCP integration inside Blender, the participant (a professional game developer) iteratively builds a scene from scratch (ball, ground, materials), animates a bouncing ball, then extends the task to two interacting balls with collision, rotation, lighting, glow materials, color-change-on-interaction, a background, and camera tracking/zoom effects, writing all prompts himself without AI assistance (no ChatGPT).

All Steps.step_action: Clear the default Blender scene and create initial primitives (a ball from a sphere, and a resized ground plane) purely from typed natural-language prompts.
